metadata.question: Did lake ice extent on Lake Winnipeg, Canada, decrease between May 7, 2021 and May 19, 2021?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 L2A (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) over a Lake Winnipeg bounding geometry. For each target date (2021-05-07 and 2021-05-19), search within expanding windows (±1, ±3, ±7, ±10, ±15, ±30 days) and pick the image with lowest CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE. Build a stable lake mask from summer 2021 Sentinel-2 SCL water class.
2. Masking strategy: Use SCL to define clouds (3,7,8,9,10), valid pixels (not clouds, not nodata/defective), and ice (11). Use pixelArea sums at 1000 m scale to get areas for water/valid/ice.
3. Valid Zero vs Null/Error: If no images after expanding windows => C1. If valid water area is 0 for either date => C2. If any computed value is null/NaN or water mask area is 0 => C3. Otherwise compare ice areas; decreased => A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); # You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const date1 = '2021-05-07';
    const date2 = '2021-05-19';

    // Approximate Lake Winnipeg geometry using two bounding polygons (south and north basins)
    const southBasin = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
      [[-97.8, 51.7], [-96.0, 51.7], [-96.0, 50.1], [-97.8, 50.1], [-97.8, 51.7]]
    ]);
    const northBasin = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
      [[-98.0, 54.1], [-96.1, 54.1], [-96.1, 52.0], [-98.0, 52.0], [-98.0, 54.1]]
    ]);
    const lakeGeom = southBasin.union(northBasin, 1);

    // 2. Build a stable water mask from summer 2021 Sentinel-2 SCL water
    const s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED');
    const summerCol = s2
      .filterBounds(lakeGeom)
      .filterDate('2021-06-15', '2021-09-15')
      .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 40))
      .select(['SCL']);
    const waterProb = summerCol.map(img => img.eq(6).rename('water')).mean();
    const waterMask = waterProb.gt(0.5).selfMask(); // stable water in the two basins

    // Precompute total water area (km2)
    const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea();
    const totalWaterArea_m2 = pixelArea.updateMask(waterMask)
      .reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: lakeGeom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e13
      }).get('area');
    const totalWaterArea = await totalWaterArea_m2.getInfo();
    if (totalWaterArea === null || totalWaterArea === undefined || totalWaterArea === 0 || isNaN(totalWaterArea)) {
      console.log('Water mask area (km2): 0.0');
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      return;
    }
    console.log('Water mask area (km2): ' + (totalWaterArea / 1e6).toFixed(1));

    // Helper to pick best Sentinel-2 image near a date
    async function pickS2ImageNear(dateStr) {
      const windows = [1, 3, 7, 10, 15, 30];
      for (let i = 0; i < windows.length; i++) {
        const w = windows[i];
        const start = ee.Date(dateStr).advance(-w, 'day');
        const end = ee.Date(dateStr).advance(w + 1, 'day'); // inclusive buffer
        const col = s2
          .filterBounds(lakeGeom)
          .filterDate(start, end)
          .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 85))
          .sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE');
        const count = await col.size().getInfo();
        if (count > 0) {
          const img = ee.Image(col.first());
          return {img: img, count: count, windowDays: w};
        }
      }
      return {img: null, count: 0, windowDays: null};
    }

    // Compute stats for a chosen S2 image
    async function computeS2IceStats(img) {
      const scl = img.select('SCL');
      // Cloud/shadow/unclassified mask
      const cloud = scl.eq(3).or(scl.eq(7)).or(scl.eq(8)).or(scl.eq(9)).or(scl.eq(10));
      const valid = cloud.not().and(scl.neq(0)).and(scl.neq(1));
      const validWater = waterMask.and(valid);
      const iceMask = scl.eq(11).and(waterMask);

      const reducers = ee.Reducer.sum();
      const validArea_m2 = pixelArea.updateMask(validWater).reduceRegion({
        reducer: reducers,
        geometry: lakeGeom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e13
      }).get('area');
      const iceArea_m2 = pixelArea.updateMask(iceMask).reduceRegion({
        reducer: reducers,
        geometry: lakeGeom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e13
      }).get('area');
      const validArea = await validArea_m2.getInfo();
      const iceArea = await iceArea_m2.getInfo();

      // Cloud area within lake
      const cloudWithinWater = waterMask.and(valid.not());
      const cloudArea_m2 = pixelArea.updateMask(cloudWithinWater).reduceRegion({
        reducer: reducers,
        geometry: lakeGeom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e13
      }).get('area');
      const cloudArea = await cloudArea_m2.getInfo();

      const imgDate = await ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo();

      return {
        date: imgDate,
        validArea: validArea || 0,
        iceArea: iceArea || 0,
        cloudPct: totalWaterArea > 0 ? (cloudArea || 0) / totalWaterArea : null
      };
    }

    // Acquire images near each date
    const pick1 = await pickS2ImageNear(date1);
    const pick2 = await pickS2ImageNear(date2);

    if (!pick1.img || !pick2.img) {
      console.log('Images near 2021-05-07: ' + (pick1.count || 0));
      console.log('Images near 2021-05-19: ' + (pick2.count || 0));
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
      return;
    }

    // Compute stats
    const stats1 = await computeS2IceStats(pick1.img);
    const stats2 = await computeS2IceStats(pick2.img);

    // Validate stats
    function invalid(v) { return v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v); }
    if (invalid(stats1.validArea) || invalid(stats2.validArea) || invalid(stats1.iceArea) || invalid(stats2.iceArea) || invalid(totalWaterArea)) {
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      return;
    }
    if (stats1.validArea === 0 || stats2.validArea === 0) {
      console.log('Selected image 1: ' + stats1.date + ', valid water km2: ' + (stats1.validArea/1e6).toFixed(1));
      console.log('Selected image 2: ' + stats2.date + ', valid water km2: ' + (stats2.validArea/1e6).toFixed(1));
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels');
      return;
    }

    // Print concise evidence
    console.log('Selected image 1: ' + stats1.date + ', cloud%: ' + (stats1.cloudPct*100).toFixed(1) + ', valid km2: ' + (stats1.validArea/1e6).toFixed(1) + ', ice km2: ' + (stats1.iceArea/1e6).toFixed(1) + ', ice/valid%: ' + (stats1.iceArea / stats1.validArea * 100).toFixed(2));
    console.log('Selected image 2: ' + stats2.date + ', cloud%: ' + (stats2.cloudPct*100).toFixed(1) + ', valid km2: ' + (stats2.validArea/1e6).toFixed(1) + ', ice km2: ' + (stats2.iceArea/1e6).toFixed(1) + ', ice/valid%: ' + (stats2.iceArea / stats2.validArea * 100).toFixed(2));

    // 5. Decision
    const deltaIce_km2 = (stats2.iceArea - stats1.iceArea) / 1e6;
    console.log('Delta ice area (km2): ' + deltaIce_km2.toFixed(2));

    if (!isFinite(deltaIce_km2)) {
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      return;
    }

    if (deltaIce_km2 < 0) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }

  } catch (err) {
    // If dataset/band names wrong or other runtime issues
    console.log('D: Error');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
